speaker: Doctor
text:
Please describe the specific nature of your flank pain and whether you have noticed any changes in the frequency or color of your urine since starting antibiotics.

REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis Leukocyturia: Present; Bacterial Culture: Negative; Cytospin Stained With Hansel’s Solution: 3% binucleated cells with eosinophilic, granular cytoplasm.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a very specific finding; have you noticed any hives, itching, or swelling of your lips or tongue since starting the antibiotic? Additionally, do you have a history of asthma or hay fever?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Interstitial Nephritis. The presence of eosinophiluria along with fever, flank pain, and fatigue following recent antibiotic use is classic for this condition. Do you recall which specific antibiotic was prescribed for your sinusitis?
